dataCollected.title: 1. Collected Data
dataCollected.intro: We only collect data required for the service to work:

sharing.title: 3. Data Sharing
sharing.content: No personal data is sold or shared with third parties. Data may only be disclosed if required by law.

storage.title: 4. Storage and Security
paragraphs: Data is stored securely. Passwords are encrypted and never stored in plain text.
Even with safeguards in place, no transmission or storage method is fully secure.

retention.title: 5. Retention Period
retention.content: Data is kept while the account remains active and can be deleted upon user request.

rights.title: 6. User Rights
rights.intro: In line with GDPR, you have the following rights:

cookies.title: 7. Cookies
cookies.content: The site may use technical cookies required for operation (login, session). No advertising cookies are used.

changes.title: 8. Changes
changes.content: This privacy policy may be updated at any time. Users will be informed of important changes.
